acceptance.given: Frontmatter input is processed by the parser during a frontmatter parse.

oracle.expected: Parsing completes with zero YAML or object constructor executions, yielding safe data or a controlled parse failure.
forbidden: Instantiating arbitrary objects from frontmatter input
oracle.observable: Instrumented constructor counters and parser outcome during frontmatter parsing.

acceptance.then: The parser completes with zero YAML or object constructor executions.
acceptance.when: During validation of the frontmatter parser, instrument YAML and object constructors and inspect their invocation counters and parse outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the frontmatter parser safety test with instrumented YAML and object constructors; fail when any constructor executes or arbitrary object instantiation occurs.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Parse frontmatter without executing YAML or object constructors and reject unsafe constructor behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the frontmatter parsing implementation; preserve existing validator result and schema contracts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frontmatter parser transitions from raw input processing to a safely parsed data value or controlled parse failure with no constructor execution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted frontmatter safety test completes and reports zero YAML/object constructor executions.
